## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `93e7d49f64302aaa020e3f04812cd7e62f9fc34f`
Local-runs: none
Scope: none (no hits; owed by the security#1 hand-off) + packages/objectql/src/engine-update.ts

### ① Derived judgments

- Order of the update door, by-id and predicate branches: the two read-only strips now run before the multi-value wrap and the first value check (`judgeStrippedPayload`). Right: it is the insert door's order, and it is what `Field.readonlyWhen` already publishes on `main` (the server ignores writes to a field whose `readonlyWhen` is TRUE).
- `readonlyWhen` predicate view: `inStoredMultiValueShape` wraps a copy of the `stored` view at all four strip call sites, so a predicate still reads a multi-valued field in list form. Right; same scope and input as before.
- Second pass (`normalizeMultiValueFields` / `validateRecordInScope` with `'only'`): untouched. Right: every value that survives the strips is still judged before the driver call.
- Declared visible change (a malformed value on a field whose `readonlyWhen` holds is dropped and reported, or refused under `strictReadonlyWrites`): right as behaviour. It is not a narrowing: no declared capability is taken away, no value is newly storable, and the spec says such a write is ignored. No migration note or BREAKING banner is owed.
- Undeclared second instance of the same change: a runtime-owned field (`RUNTIME_OWNED_FIELD_TYPES`) with no `readonly: true` is taken by the static strip, so a malformed value there is now dropped under `readonly` instead of refused. Same direction; nit N1.
- Hand-off claim that the head's tree equals `126f932d67`: confirmed (same tree).
- Gate verdicts on this head when read: 23 success, 20 skipped, 0 failed, 11 still in progress (Test Core 1/8 to 8/8, Build Core, two Type Check jobs). This record covers the design; landing still needs those green.

### ② Semver level

- `@objectstack/objectql` patch: right. A fix in a released package, no public export or option added. Check Changeset is green.
- `Clause-②: no`: right. A call that was refused now completes without the dropped field, but no accepted value and no public surface widens, and the result is the behaviour the spec declares.
- `Metadata-protocol: none`: right.

### ③ Boundary flags

- No card and no dev report, so no dev flags or `open_questions` to answer.
- The hand-off's one declared visible change is answered in ① and ②.
- PR author is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`: no off-relay author note is owed.

### ④ Design judgment

`packages/objectql/src/engine-update.ts`: the reorder holds against the code it cites. Read and not broken: parent reads that now precede the value check bind only a scalar; a dropped value reaches only its own lock's verdict (`settleReadonlyWhenDrops`); `judgeStrippedPayload` sits outside the `isSystem` and `payloadHasReadonlyWhen` gates, so every caller is still judged on both branches; no early return sits between the old and new positions; no other update path calls the value check.

Findings:
- should-fix S1 — `UpdateFacet.update`, both branches: the rule as titled ("judges and stores the payload left after the fields the caller may not write are removed") is held here for the multi-value wrap and the first value check only, not yet for every engine pass that precedes the strips in those branches. Required: hold the same order for the remaining pass in this PR, or scope the stated rule (title, changeset first line, test header) to what this diff moves and route the remainder through the security#1 seat. Detail held by review#2.
- should-fix S2 — read against `ValidateDataResponseSchema` and the import row report in `packages/spec/src/api`: their named limit says an `update`-mode preview can report fewer drops than the update. After this change the preview can also refuse a row the update accepts (the safe direction). Required: the changeset names this preview divergence, and a follow-up card widens the two limit sentences. No spec edit in this PR.
- nit N1 — changeset and PR body say "One visible change"; the runtime-owned case in ① is a second instance. Prose fix: "a field either strip removes".
- nit N2 — `ReadonlyValueScope` jsdoc in `packages/objectql/src/validation/record-validator.ts` still describes the old order. Outside the diff: follow-up.
- nit N3 — a value-check refusal on a writable field now arrives after the strips have already reported their drops; later refusals already behaved this way. Accepted deviation.
- nit N4 — the changeset's `strictReadonlyWrites` arm and the predicate-branch arm have no pin in the new test file. Follow-up.

S1 and S2 earn a delta review of their fix by this seat.
